comparison_design.selected: Run the same one-step teacher-forced action-fit audit over the four already-saved StageE1 checkpoints, using the same 5 training demonstrations, stride 5, HDF5 source, image/state construction, and observation-keyed sampling noise.

alternatives_deferred.reason: The predeclared 0/50 closed-loop failure is already established; another failure-rate estimate would not explain training progression.

alternatives_deferred.option: Start StageE2 or retrain with different settings/data
alternatives_deferred.reason: StageE1 has not passed its 28/50 gate, and the existing saved training trajectory had not yet been checked for action-fit progression.

comparison_design.decision_reason: This bounded read-only comparison directly checks supervised fit progression without changing training, data, evaluation protocol, or checkpoints.

source.instruction: pick up the akita black bowl and place it on the plate in the left region
source.checkpoint_verification: All four checkpoint model.safetensors files were present; the 10000-step SHA256 matches the existing StageE1 control-chain record.

inference_randomness_audit.finding: SmolVLAPolicy.select_action calls sample_actions with noise=None; the model then samples initial action noise with torch.normal. Strict deterministic-algorithm settings do not seed this RNG input.

unseeded_same_checkpoint_observations.interpretation: The same checkpoint and data gave different unseeded one-step MAE; do not compare unseeded outputs as an exact learning curve.

fixed_noise_control.mechanism: Reset torch CPU and CUDA RNG immediately before each policy prediction, giving the same initial noise for a given demo/frame across checkpoints.

inference_randomness_audit.first_correct_run: An initial pass used the adjacent teacher_native_task0_current_pipeline checkpoint family. Those outputs are preserved but excluded: its 10000-step model hash differs from the StageE1 checkpoint hash.

audit_script.change: Added an optional observation-keyed inference seed; default behavior remains backward-compatible when the option is omitted.

interpretation.confirmed: With fixed observation-keyed inference noise, training-set one-step action MAE decreased from 0.02648 at 2500 steps to 0.00869 at 10000 steps (about 67% lower). The 10000-step fixed-noise full result reproduced exactly in a second full run.
interpretation.not_monotonic_by_every_channel: The gripper channel MAE increased slightly from 0.11316 at 2500 to 0.11959 at 5000, then decreased to 0.04158 by 10000.
does_not_establish: This is in-sample teacher-forced fit on five training demonstrations, not held-out generalization.
Improved action fit does not establish why StageE1 still has 0/50 strict closed-loop successes or 0/5 zero-wait demo-start successes.
This does not satisfy the StageE1 closed-loop gate and does not authorize StageE2, additional training, or Fold02.
interpretation.stageE1_gate_unchanged: 0/50 strict held-out successes; 0/5 zero-wait demo-start successes; gate remains failed.

options_compared.option: Read-only provenance audit of the historical purportedly successful checkpoint: identify its exact BDDL/task identity, environment/evaluator version, initial-state manifest, and seed-level outcomes; determine whether the reported success is comparable to current StageE1 task0.
options_compared.reason: The task-matched StageE1 model did not pass, and the historical checkpoint comparison on current custom-task starts was 0/5. Before any training change, establish whether a valid same-task known-good evaluation control actually exists and whether the evaluator reproduces its original conditions.
The one-task StageE1 closed-loop gate failed; scaling now would violate the teacher-directed prerequisite and confound training-pipeline versus multitask conclusions.

options_compared.option: Extend or alter StageE1 training immediately
options_compared.reason: Action fit improves across the saved checkpoints; changing the recipe now would not isolate the unresolved closed-loop gap. First verify the historical control and original evaluation protocol.

next_phase_plan.selected_scope: Read-only artifact/protocol provenance audit only; no GPU rollout or training until the original historical task and evaluation conditions are established.
next_phase_plan.stop_condition: If original task identity, seeds, or success records cannot be recovered from existing files, stop and report the exact missing evidence; do not substitute another model/task.
